name: Upper (campus variant, return from illness)

exercises.note: PROVISIONAL loads. 40 was very easy, 55 at RIR 3, 60 x 8 anyway. Not the Hammer Strength at Fitness Park.
7-6-5 bodyweight at constant effort. Best part of the day - no sign of a week off.
PROVISIONAL loads. 50 x 10 twice with 3 in reserve.

notes: First session back after seven days ill (17-22 Sep) and the first upper-body session ever at the campus gym. Deliberately submaximal: RIR 3 throughout, no set to failure, half the usual volume. He stopped after 9 sets because he was still not fully recovered, and told me not to treat today's numbers as his working loads - correct on both counts. Shoulder press, face pulls and cable lateral raises were dropped. Every load today is a floor: next campus upper day opens at these numbers and climbs from set 2.
